The INCIA 100% Natural Easy Combing Spray is made to turn after-bath detangling into a calm, tear-free moment for you and your little one. This 100% natural leave-in spray glides through knots and tangles, even in fine, wavy or curly hair, so brushing feels gentle instead of a struggle. It is free from petrochemicals, silicones, artificial colours and alcohol, with a light, naturally fruity and floral scent.

At its heart is PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate, a mild conditioning active derived from coconut oil and natural amino acids. It sinks into the hair to soften and hydrate from within, leaving strands silky and easy to comb. There is no need to rinse: the formula is designed to stay in the hair for a lasting, smoothing effect, and the bottle is 100% recyclable.

Key benefits

  • Detangles knots effortlessly, for happier brushing time
  • No-rinse leave-in formula, spray on wet or dry hair and comb through
  • PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate from coconut oil conditions and hydrates
  • Tames flyaways and adds a natural shine without weighing hair down
  • Free from petrochemicals, silicones, artificial colours and alcohol
  • Suitable for all hair types, including fine hair and sensitive scalps
  • 100% recyclable packaging, kinder to soil and water

How to use

Shake well before use. Spray evenly over wet or dry hair, whichever you prefer, then gently comb through. There is no need to rinse: it is made to stay in the hair for a lasting effect. For a little extra care, follow with a natural baby oil as a finishing touch.

Ingredients

Full ingredients: Aqua, Butylene Glycol, Glycerin, PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate, Triethyl Citrate, Cinnamomum Zeylanicum Bark Extract, Caprylyl Glycol, Parfum, Linalool, Limonene.

  • PCA Ethyl Cocoyl Arginate: a gentle coconut-derived conditioning active that softens hair and helps loosen tangles without weighing it down.
  • Glycerin: a natural humectant that draws moisture into the hair shaft, making strands suppler and easier to comb.
  • Cinnamon bark extract: brings antioxidant qualities to the blend and a warm, natural note.

Frequently asked questions

Can I use it on both wet and dry hair?
Yes. Spray it onto wet or dry hair and comb through gently. No rinsing needed: the spray is designed to stay in the hair for a lasting, smoothing effect.

Does it work on curly or thick hair?
Yes. It suits all hair types, including fine, wavy and curly hair. The coconut amino acid complex bonds to the hair and eases out tangles without making it feel heavy.

Is it safe for children and sensitive scalps?
Yes. The ingredients are pure and carefully chosen with children and the environment in mind. It is free from alcohol, silicones and synthetic actives, and made with young scalps in mind. If your child has a scalp condition, check with your GP or pharmacist first.

Is it really 100% natural?
Yes. Every ingredient is naturally derived, with no petrochemicals, silicones or artificial colours, and the packaging is fully recyclable.

Suitable for both babies and adults, the gel absorbs quickly. Apply it two to three times a day to dry or irritated areas; even a thin layer helps hydrate moisture-poor skin. Alongside it you will find sesame, sweet almond, argan and apricot kernel oils, all rich in antioxidants that help protect hairs against everyday environmental stress.   • Conditions lashes and brows for a fuller, healthier look

  • Argan, sesame, apricot kernel and sweet almond oils nourish the hairs

Before bed, apply one drop of the serum with the pipette to your lashes and brows, then massage in gently with your fingertips. Apply the serum every evening before bed. With regular use, many people notice the first results within one to three weeks.

The product is 100% natural. Even so, we recommend taking care on first use, as hormonal changes during pregnancy can sometimes cause unexpected reactions. We always suggest discussing it with your GP or midwife first.

Yes. It doubles as a brow serum and makes a lovely conditioning base before shaping and grooming your brows.

INCIA Kids Lip Balm Orange is a 100% natural lip balm made for little lips, with a cheerful orange scent that turns lip care into a treat children actually want. Children's lips chap easily because they have no oil-producing glands of their own, so they lose moisture quickly in cold, dry or sunny weather. This gentle stick lays down a light, protective layer that helps lock in moisture, so your child's lips stay soft and cared for through the school run, the playground and family holidays. Because every ingredient is naturally derived, a little accidental lick is nothing to worry about.

  • 100% natural formula, made with children in mind

Make sure your child's lips are clean and dry, then twist the base of the stick to bring the balm up. Frequently asked questions

Can I use it every day on sensitive areas?
Yes. Use it as often as you like, on face and body. The formula is 100% natural, fragrance-free and free from synthetic ingredients, so it suits sensitive skin. For a persistent concern, check with your GP or pharmacist.

Are sea buckthorn and shea butter ok for very sensitive skin?
Both are mild and nourishing. No synthetic ingredients, fragrance or preservatives, so it works even for sensitive skin. For a serious skin condition, speak to your GP.

Does it help with redness or small dry patches?
It supports the skin's natural barrier, so dry or rough patches feel calmer. Handy for insect bites, scrapes and sun-exposed skin too. For ongoing concerns, see your GP or a dermatologist.

Is it fragrance-free?
Completely. No synthetic fragrance, nothing added; every ingredient is 100% naturally derived.

Many of us have stretch marks. They appear as fine streaks on the skin when the connective tissue beneath is stretched, which is why they are so common during pregnancy. The INCIA Stretch Mark Gel Cream was developed by INCIA especially for use through pregnancy, to help keep skin nourished, supple and cared for as it changes.

This rich, 100% natural cream deeply hydrates and helps reduce moisture loss, so skin stays soft and comfortable. It is designed to help prevent the appearance of stretch marks and to support the skin's suppleness, and it can be used throughout pregnancy and for up to three months afterwards to support recovery. Whether you are pregnant, going through weight changes or simply looking after dry skin, it delivers intensive nourishment.

Key benefits

  • Helps prevent the appearance of stretch marks (striae)
  • Deeply hydrates and helps reduce moisture loss
  • Supports the skin's suppleness and elasticity as it stretches
  • Rich in shea butter, sweet almond and avocado oils for a natural, nourished feel
  • Safe to use during pregnancy and for up to three months afterwards
  • Made with 100% natural ingredients, with no synthetic fragrances or colourants

How to use

Massage the cream into the skin throughout pregnancy to help head off the development of stretch marks, focusing on the tummy, hips, thighs, bottom and bust. Daily use through pregnancy gives the best preventive results, and the cream may also be used for up to three months after birth to support the skin as it recovers. If you have any questions about use during pregnancy, check with your GP, pharmacist or midwife.

Frequently asked questions

Is the cream safe during pregnancy and breastfeeding?
Yes. The cream was developed especially for use during pregnancy and is suitable from the third month onwards, and for up to three months after birth. If you are ever unsure, check with your GP, pharmacist or midwife.

Does it reduce existing stretch marks, or is it mainly preventive?
Both. Its main role is preventive, keeping skin hydrated and supple, but it also helps support the look of existing stretch marks thanks to its naturally derived actives. Results with existing marks vary from person to person.

Is it suitable for sensitive skin or eczema?
It is made with 100% natural ingredients and no synthetic additives, though it does contain soy-derived ingredients. If your skin is sensitive or prone to eczema, patch test on a small area first, and speak to a GP or dermatologist if you have concerns.

How long until I see results with regular use?
For the best preventive results, apply daily throughout pregnancy. With existing stretch marks, the visible improvement varies from person to person, depending on skin structure and how established the marks are.
